pairs.description: Two hook installers at different scopes that share only an idempotent write skeleton. installGlobalHook maintains a devkit block inside the machine-global init.sh (single file, strip-then-reinsert, no git config). installOverlayHook writes a repo's .devkit/hooks/pre-commit plus pass-through wrappers for every other existing hook, chmods them, and sets core.hooksPath. Matched as drifted (code 0.87, description 0.90) because both read as 'install a devkit hook idempotently'; merging them would couple machine-global state with per-repo git config. Pre-existing pair, surfaced when an unrelated change staged overlay.mts.
Registration removal rewrites consumer-owned Claude/Cursor settings while script removal deletes Devkit manifest-owned files; their parallel lifecycle shape preserves separate ownership boundaries.
